card.name: NSAID GI bleeding warning wording
card.fires_on: Words in the NSAID boxed warning about stomach and intestinal bleeding, such as 'intestine' ending the list of organs and 'time' in 'at any time'. It also fires on 'renal' in 'acute renal failure'.

modes.label: End of GI organ list
modes.description: The word 'intestine' closing the list of digestive organs in the GI perforation warning.
modes.example: small intestine, or large<< intestine>>, which can be fatal.

modes.label: At any time
modes.description: The word 'time' in 'can occur at any time during use'.
modes.example: These events can occur at any<< time>> during use and without warning symptoms.

modes.label: Acute renal failure
modes.description: The word 'renal' inside 'acute renal failure' in the dual RAS blockade warning.
modes.example: changes in renal function (including acute<< renal>> failure) compared to monotherapy.

card.writes: Suppresses words meaning 'related' or 'cascade', so it discourages continuing with linking terms and favors ending the phrase.
card.plain: It marks fixed wording in standard warnings about stomach bleeding and kidney failure from certain drugs.
